Imodeli yehlulekile ku-GPU. Inkumbulo ye-GPU incane kakhulu kunenkumbulo yesistimu. Ukuzama okulandelayo kuzosebenzisa i-CPU. Ukuze usebenzise i-CPU ngaso sonke isikhathi, setha i-Compute ku-CPU kuzilungiselelo. Ungaphinde ukhethe imodeli encane.
Imodeli ayilayishanga. Ifayela cishe lonakele. Susa imodeli kuzilungiselelo bese uyilanda futhi.
Le modeli idinga cishe %1$s yememori, kanti %2$s ikhululekile. Vala ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, noma khetha imodeli encane.
Imodeli iphelelwe yinkumbulo, noma yehlulekile. Khetha imodeli encane.
Imodeli yehlulekile ku-NPU. Zama okulandelayo usebenzisa i-GPU noma i-CPU. Umbhalo omude ungase ube mkhulu kakhulu okwakhiwe kwi-NPU yemodeli.
Ukwakhiwa kwe-NPU kuphela kwale modeli okusefonini yakho, futhi i-NPU kuphela engayisebenzisa. Setha i-Compute ku-NPU, noma landa ukwakhiwa okujwayelekile kwemodeli kuzilungiselelo.
I-NPU build yalolu hlelo ayizange iqale ocingweni lwakho. Ukuze usebenzise uhlelo ku-GPU noma ku-CPU, landa i-standard build yalo kuzilungiselelo.
Ingxenye ye-NPU yekhibhodi ayilungile. Uma ilanda, zama futhi ngesikhashana. Ukuze usebenzise i-GPU noma i-CPU manje, landa ukwakhiwa okujwayelekile kwemodeli kuzilungiselelo.

Umbhalo mude kakhulu kule modeli. Sebenzisa umbhalo omfushane, noma wandise usayizi womongo kuzilungiselelo.
